run_VAD_segmentation: run the prepare_vads script to transform per-frame VAD files into speech activity segments using multiprocessing
parse_vad_file: parse a .vad file and return a list of silence probability floats from space-separated values
split_vad_segments: split a list of silence probabilities into speech activity segments using threshold and minimum length parameters
process_vad_task: process a single VAD file task by parsing probabilities and splitting into speech segments
get_args_VAD: get command-line arguments for VAD processing including vad_root, thresholds, workers, and output path
